name: core-ruffle
description: Required for Ruffle playback of Flash games

com.ruffle.enabled.title: Enabled (Supported Games)
com.ruffle.enabled.description: Enables Ruffle for games that have been marked as properly supported.

com.ruffle.enabled-all.title: Enabled (Unsupported Games)
com.ruffle.enabled-all.description: Enables Ruffle Standalone for all games regardless of whether they have been checked as supported. Results my vary.

com.ruffle.use-launcher-embed.title: Use Launcher Embed
com.ruffle.use-launcher-embed.description: Uses Ruffle embedded in the Launcher instead of the Standalone application. Saves will not carry over.

com.ruffle.graphics-mode.title: Graphics Mode
com.ruffle.graphics-mode.description: Switches the graphics mode used when running games in Ruffle.
